title.zh: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address
title.en: ETH wallet exploit backfires as MEV bot captures $7.7M, Kelp freezes address

current_state.zh: An attacker exploiting a custom Safe module to extract ~$7.7M in rsETH was front-run by the MEV bot 'Yoink,' which captured the funds before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.
current_state.en: An attacker exploiting a custom Safe module to extract ~$7.7M in rsETH was front-run by the MEV bot 'Yoink,' which captured the funds before Kelp temporarily froze the receiving address.
